stops.title: Trigonometric equations & general solutions
stops.inShort: sin θ = sin α ⇒ θ = nπ + (−1)^n α; cos θ = cos α ⇒ θ = 2nπ ± α; tan θ = tan α ⇒ θ = nπ + α. For sin²θ = sin²α (or cos² or tan²): θ = nπ ± α.

stops.title: Solution of a triangle (Sine, Cosine & Projection rules)
stops.inShort: Sine rule: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C = 2R. Cosine rule: a² = b² + c² − 2bc cos A. Projection rule: a = b cos C + c cos B. Hero's formula: Δ = √(s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)).

stops.title: Inverse trigonometric functions
stops.inShort: Principal value branches: sin⁻¹x ∈ [−π/2, π/2], cos⁻¹x ∈ [0, π], tan⁻¹x ∈ (−π/2, π/2). Key identities: sin⁻¹x + cos⁻¹x = π/2; tan⁻¹x + tan⁻¹y = tan⁻¹((x+y)/(1−xy)) for xy < 1.

items.f: sin θ = sin α ⇒ θ = nπ + (−1)^n α;  cos θ = cos α ⇒ 2nπ ± α;  tan²θ = tan²α ⇒ nπ ± α
b² = c² + a² − 2ca cos B,  a = b cos C + c cos B

board.text: In ΔABC, (a + b)·cos C + (b + c)·cos A + (c + a)·cos B is equal to ____.
board.answer: (c) a + b + c (regrouping by projection rule: (b cos C + c cos B) + (c cos A + a cos C) + (a cos B + b cos A) = a + b + c).

board.text: Find the general solution of tan²θ = 1.
board.answer:
tan²θ = 1 = (1)² = tan²(π/4).
Since tan²θ = tan²α ⇒ θ = nπ ± α, n ∈ Z,
θ = nπ ± π/4, where n ∈ Z.

points.text: General solution θ = nπ ± π/4, n ∈ Z

board.text: In ΔABC, if c² + a² − b² = ac, then ∠B = ____.
board.answer: (b) π/3 (cos B = (c² + a² − b²)/(2ac) = ac/(2ac) = 1/2 ⇒ ∠B = π/3).

board.text: Find the principal value of cot⁻¹(−1/√3).
board.answer:
Let cot⁻¹(−1/√3) = y ∈ (0, π). Then cot y = −1/√3 = −cot(π/3) = cot(π − π/3) = cot(2π/3).
Principal value = 2π/3.
